records.text: Chris Rafferty, a viewer display name with unverified identity, rhetorically asked why Turning Point USA would be paying to obfuscate the investigation into its founder’s murder, saying the question sent chills up their spine and that they did not know the answer.
records.speaker: Chris Rafferty (viewer commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Nasty elephant droppings. I agree with you. Um, Charlie (Charlie Kirk), with your help, organically created a juggernaut. They spoiled his message and integrity at every turn. You really are his best friend. Shame on his so-called friends. It's so gross that they would engage in this and, and then gaslight us. This is like such a Blake Neff thing. What are you talking about? We don't have friends in high places. Chris Rafferty writes, the disturbing part of all this clipping nonsense is the why. I don't, I don't know the answer. ... I could guess, but just the question, why would Turning Point USA be paying to obfuscate the investigation into the murder of their founder? ... That is what sends chills up my spine. Yes. And when I got looking at that date and I saw, oh, okay, they've wiped the September 12th archive.
